issue_context.title: Add dropdown searching support
issue_context.body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/17020
Originally posted by **Coppertine** February 28, 2022 Like above, when working with long dropdown lists (i.e. List of Players in a tournament or list of skins) it's difficult to find a spesific thing within said list. The idea is that when focused within the dropdown list, you can press the key of the first letter for the cursor to jump to the first occurence, following with another letter with jump the cursor to the list item that starts with the sequence of characters typed and etc for all characters typed. This would be simlar to selecting a spesific file in File Explorer using just your keyboard. Another idea is to use the Dropdown box as a search bar that is typeable that would filter the list down. Similar to the song select search functionaility.

review_comments: A bit dodgy, but I guess it'll do for now. Until it falls over for another reason.
